# What does this PR do?

ModelOpt pruning needs a hybrid model whose MoE experts use separate linear layers instead of grouped GEMM. This change adds a statically composed `hybrid_stack_spec_no_moe_grouped_gemm` next to the existing grouped-GEMM spec.

Callers choose the named spec at model construction time, so the exact implementation remains visible from the module spec and does not switch from a runtime boolean. The existing `hybrid_stack_spec` behavior is unchanged. ModelOpt now reuses the shared static spec instead of maintaining a partial duplicate, and the Mamba compatibility name is retained.

## Issue tracking

Fixes #4106

## Contribution process

### Pre-checks

- [x] I have added relevant unit tests
- [ ] I have added relevant functional tests
- [x] I have added proper typing to my code [Typing guidelines](https://docs.python.org/3/library/typing.html)
- [ ] I have added relevant documentation
- [ ] I have run the [autoformatter.sh](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/main/tools/autoformat.sh) on my PR

### Validation

- Unit coverage verifies the fixed non-grouped MoE composition, preserved neighboring hybrid layers, and Mamba compatibility alias.
- `python3 -m py_compile`, Black 26.3.0, isort 5.13.2, `git diff --check`, and a static-spec contract check passed.
- The repaired design follows `megatron/core/models/hybrid/AGENTS.md`: no CLI, configuration, or runtime boolean selects behavior inside `hybrid_layer_specs.py`.

The repaired commit is rebased on current `main` and signed. Runtime GPU-dependent model tests remain a hosted CI gate.

+# Copyright (c) 2026, NVIDIA CORPORATION. All rights reserved.
+
+"""Tests for configurable hybrid-stack module specs."""
+
+from megatron.core.models.hybrid import hybrid_layer_specs
+
+
+def test_no_grouped_gemm_hybrid_stack_spec_has_static_moe_implementation():
+    stack_spec = hybrid_layer_specs.hybrid_stack_spec_no_moe_grouped_gemm
+
+    assert stack_spec.submodules.moe_layer.submodules.mlp is hybrid_layer_specs.moe_no_grouped_gemm
+    assert (
+        stack_spec.submodules.moe_layer.module
+        is hybrid_layer_specs.hybrid_stack_spec.submodules.moe_layer.module
+    )
+    assert (
+        stack_spec.submodules.mamba_layer
+        is hybrid_layer_specs.hybrid_stack_spec.submodules.mamba_layer
+    )
+    assert (
+        stack_spec.submodules.csa_layer is hybrid_layer_specs.hybrid_stack_spec.submodules.csa_layer
+    )
+
+
+def test_no_grouped_gemm_mamba_stack_spec_is_backward_compatible_alias():
+    assert (
+        hybrid_layer_specs.mamba_stack_spec_no_moe_grouped_gemm
+        is hybrid_layer_specs.hybrid_stack_spec_no_moe_grouped_gemm
+    )
